en.name: JSON to PDF Converter
en.description: Convert JSON data to PDF format. This JSON to PDF converter lets you generate printable PDF documents from your JSON data, with configurable font size and page orientation — all in your browser.

hero.trustHtml: 100% client-side conversion. Your data never leaves your browser.

meta.title: JSON to PDF — Free Online Converter
meta.description: Convert JSON data to PDF format online. Generate printable PDF documents from JSON with configurable font size and orientation. Free, fast, and 100% client-side.

features.title: PDF Export
features.description: Generate real PDF documents from JSON data. The output uses a monospace font and proper indentation for clear, readable JSON in PDF form.

features.title: Copy Output
features.description: Copy the formatted JSON text to your clipboard. Use it in documentation, emails, or other text-based workflows without downloading a file.

features.title: Multiple Formats
features.description: Download the result as a PDF for printing and sharing, or as a plain text (.txt) file for further processing in code editors or scripts.

features.title: Customizable
features.description: Adjust font size (8–14pt) and page orientation (portrait or landscape) to fit your content and preferred reading or printing style.

features.title: File Upload
features.description: Upload .json files directly from your device for conversion. The file is read locally in your browser and is not uploaded to any server.

features.title: Private
features.description: All JSON formatting and PDF generation happen in your browser. Your data is not uploaded to a server, which is useful when working with private reports or sensitive JSON data.

guide.title: Paste your JSON
guide.description: Paste your JSON data into the input field or upload a .json file. You can use API responses, configuration snippets, reports, or any JSON you want to render as a PDF.

guide.title: Preview & Configure
guide.description: Click Preview to see how the formatted JSON will look in the PDF. Adjust font size and page orientation to optimize readability and fit for your content.

guide.title: Download PDF
guide.description: Download the generated PDF to your device. Use it for documentation, sharing with non-technical users, printing, or archiving JSON data in a readable format.

example.output: [Download PDF] — formatted JSON document with proper indentation and layout
example.useCase: Export JSON-formatted report data as printable PDF documents.

faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All JSON formatting and PDF generation happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device and is not stored or transmitted anywhere.

faq.question: What does the PDF look like?
faq.answer: The PDF contains your JSON data formatted with proper indentation using a monospace font for readability. The layout matches the preview shown before download.

faq.question: Can I customize the PDF layout?
faq.answer: Yes. You can adjust the font size (8–14pt) and page orientation (portrait or landscape) to fit your content and preferred reading or printing style.

faq.question: Can I convert large JSON files?
faq.answer: You can convert larger JSON files as long as they can be loaded and processed by your browser. The practical limit depends on available memory, device performance, and the complexity of the JSON structure.

faq.question: Why would I convert JSON to PDF?
faq.answer: Converting JSON to PDF is useful for documentation, sharing with non-technical users, printing, or archiving JSON data in a readable, platform-independent format.

faq.question: Can I also download as text?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the 'Download TXT' button to get a plain text version of your formatted JSON, which you can open in any text editor or use in scripts.

faq.question: Is the PDF searchable?
faq.answer: Yes. The generated PDF contains selectable, searchable text. You can search for keys, values, or any part of the JSON content using your PDF viewer's search feature.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON to PDF converter?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online JSON to PDF converter. You can paste JSON or upload files, preview the layout, and download PDF or TXT without creating an account or uploading data to a server.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有 JSON 格式化和 PDF 生成都在浏览器本地完成，数据不会离开你的设备，也不会被存储或传输到任何地方。

faq.question: PDF 是什么样子的？
faq.answer: PDF 包含使用等宽字体格式化的 JSON 数据，带有正确的缩进，便于阅读。布局与下载前显示的预览一致。

faq.question: 可以自定义 PDF 布局吗？
faq.answer: 可以。你可以调整字体大小（8–14pt）和页面方向（纵向或横向），以适配你的内容和偏好的阅读或打印风格。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以转换较大的 JSON 文件，只要浏览器能够加载和处理它们。实际限制取决于设备性能、浏览器可用内存以及 JSON 结构的复杂程度。

faq.question: 为什么要将 JSON 转换为 PDF？
faq.answer: 将 JSON 转为 PDF 适用于文档编写、与非技术用户共享、打印或以可读、跨平台的格式存档 JSON 数据。

faq.question: 可以下载为文本格式吗？
faq.answer: 可以。使用“下载 TXT”按钮获取格式化 JSON 的纯文本版本，可以在任何文本编辑器中打开或在脚本中使用。

faq.question: PDF 可以搜索吗？
faq.answer: 可以。生成的 PDF 包含可选择、可搜索的文本。你可以使用 PDF 阅读器的搜索功能查找键名、值或 JSON 内容中的任意部分。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的 JSON 转 PDF 转换器吗？
faq.answer: 是的。这是一个免费的在线 JSON 转 PDF 转换器。你可以粘贴 JSON 或上传文件，预览布局，并下载 PDF 或 TXT，无需创建账号或将数据上传到服务器。
